question: Muestra un gráfico de barras de las ventas totales por categoría.
question_en: Show a bar chart of total sales by category.

spec.sql: SELECT category, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM orders GROUP BY category
spec.title: Total Sales by Category

question: Muestra un gráfico de barras del beneficio total por región.
question_en: Show a bar chart of total profit by region.

spec.sql: SELECT region, SUM(profit) AS total_profit FROM orders GROUP BY region
spec.title: Total Profit by Region

question: Muestra un gráfico circular del número de pedidos por segmento.
question_en: Show a pie chart of order count by segment.

spec.sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS num_orders FROM orders GROUP BY segment
spec.title: Pedidos por segmento

question: Muestra un gráfico de barras del descuento medio por modo de envío.
question_en: Show a bar chart of average discount by ship mode.

spec.sql: SELECT ship_mode, AVG(discount) AS avg_discount FROM orders GROUP BY ship_mode
spec.title: Descuento medio por modo de envío

question: Muestra un gráfico de líneas de las ventas mensuales en 2017.
question_en: Show a line chart of monthly sales in 2017.

spec.sql: SELECT order_date, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2017-01-01' AND order_date < '2017-02-01' GROUP BY order_date
spec.title: Ventas mensuales en 2017

question: Muestra un gráfico de barras de la cantidad total vendida por subcategoría.
question_en: Show a bar chart of total quantity sold by sub-category.

spec.sql: SELECT sub_category, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM orders GROUP BY sub_category
spec.title: Total Sales by Subcategory

question: Muestra un diagrama de caja del beneficio para los pedidos del segmento Consumer.
question_en: Show a boxplot of profit for orders in the Consumer segment.

spec.sql: SELECT SUM(profit) AS total_profit, category, sub_category FROM orders WHERE segment = 'Consumer' GROUP BY category, sub_category
spec.title: Consumer Segment Profit

question: Muestra un histograma de los valores de venta inferiores a 500 $.
question_en: Show a histogram of sales values under $500.

spec.sql: SELECT SUM(sales) AS total_sales, category FROM orders WHERE sales < 500 GROUP BY category
spec.title: Histograma de ventas inferiores a 500 $

question: Muestra un diagrama de dispersión del descuento frente al beneficio para los pedidos de la categoría Technology.
question_en: Show a scatter plot of discount versus profit for orders in the Technology category.

spec.sql: SELECT discount, profit FROM orders WHERE category = 'Technology'
spec.title: Discount vs Profit for Technology Orders

question: Muestra un gráfico de líneas del beneficio a lo largo del tiempo para la región East en 2017.
question_en: Show a line chart of profit over time for the East region in 2017.
